meta.name: perf-investigation-logger
meta.description: Use when appending structured perf investigation notes and evidence.

copy.tagline: 记录性能调查笔记与证据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在排查性能问题时需要系统化记录调查过程和证据
copy.tagline_en: Log structured performance investigation notes and evidence
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically record investigation steps and evidence during performance debugging

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在性能调查过程中，将结构化的调查笔记和证据追加到指定文件中，包括用户原话、阶段总结、决策理由和证据指针。
howto.when: 当用户要求记录性能调查笔记或追加证据时触发。

say.text: 记录这次性能调查的笔记
say.note: Claude 会创建或追加结构化笔记。

say.text: 把刚才的测试结果追加到调查记录中
say.note: Claude 会添加证据和决策。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude appends structured investigation notes and evidence to a specified file during performance investigations, including verbatim user quotes, phase summaries, decisions, and evidence pointers.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to log performance investigation notes or append evidence.

say_en.text: Log the notes for this performance investigation.
say_en.note: Claude will create or append structured notes.

say_en.text: Append the test results to the investigation record.
say_en.note: Claude will add evidence and decisions.
